description: This file implements compression and decompression functions using various algorithms such as Out, Deflate, Zlib, Gzip, V42bis, and LZS (conditionally). It handles the decompression operations within a cryptography context for the ANSC (Advanced Networking Service Container) environment, providing an interface for compressing/decompressing data buffers, with some platform-specific conditional support.

methods.name: ANSC_STATUS AnscCryptoDecompress(ULONG algorithm,PVOID compact,ULONG size,PVOID plain,PULONG pOutSize)
methods.description: Main entry point for decompression, selecting the specific algorithm based on input parameter.

methods.name: ANSC_STATUS AnscCryptoOutDecompress(PVOID compact,ULONG size,PVOID plain,PULONG pOutSize)
methods.description: Stub function, currently returns input size, placeholder for out decompression logic.

methods.name: ANSC_STATUS AnscCryptoDeflateDecompress(PVOID compact,ULONG size,PVOID plain,PULONG pOutSize)
methods.description: Stub function, currently returns input size, placeholder for deflate decompression logic.

methods.name: ANSC_STATUS AnscCryptoLzsDecompress(PVOID compact,ULONG size,PVOID plain,PULONG pOutSize)
methods.description: Performs LZS decompression with temporary memory allocations; only included if _ANSC_LZS_USED_ is defined.

methods.name: ANSC_STATUS AnscCryptoV42bisDecompress(PVOID compact,ULONG size,PVOID plain,PULONG pOutSize)
methods.description: Stub function for V42bis decompression, returns size.

methods.name: ANSC_STATUS AnscCryptoZlibDecompress(PVOID compact,ULONG size,PVOID plain,PULONG pOutSize)
methods.description: Uses the zlib 'uncompress' function to decompress data, with error handling.

methods.name: ANSC_STATUS AnscCryptoGzipDecompress(PVOID compact,ULONG size,PVOID plain,PULONG pOutSize)
methods.description: Handles gzip decompression, performs validity checks and length extraction, uses gzip-specific functions if enabled.
